review.description: S1-S8 synchronization, request budgets, durable review claims and retained item history remain unchanged. Continuation restores one accepted run and does not create another review-request episode. Fresh source checks now report scope/head changes to the same agent; a closed issue or closed/merged PR terminates source sessions without removing history, and reopening cannot revive them. Terminated work shows Stopped with Send disabled and cleanup retained.
review.implementation: Reviewed startup continuation against review-claim validation and saved item/run identities. Shared domain flags are run-only; GitHub summary/detail and quota paths are unchanged. Reviewed CurrentWorkItem conditional revalidation, continuationContext structured before/current facts, sourceSnapshot retention and terminateRun/stopClosedItem. Launch checks before provider creation; import stops active work and stales questions. Cleanup preserves terminal status on dirty refusal.
review.tests: Existing pagination, polling and automatic-review duplicate/restart tests remain mapped. New same-thread and repeated-recovery assertions supplement run behavior without claiming new upstream request or synchronization results. Read continuation fixtures for changed body/assignment/head, unknown legacy baseline, failed-source exclusion, closed issue/PR/merge, reopening rejection, pending-question closure and synced active termination. Provider fixture proves cached open lifecycle is revalidated without stale fallback; both themes assert terminal controls.
